building.dim_lights: Lowers the lights in one group by a percent until the end time. Use when a sale needs less lighting power and that group's lights are on, free groups first. Not on stairs, exit signs, emergency lights or security lights. Response: The controller plans every 5 minutes, and the guard checks each write in about 1 second. After it ends: Nothing to pay back. Limit: Never dim past 50%. A call above the target's limit and under 100 goes out at that limit, as adjusted. Limit: A zone on an egress path keeps 1 footcandle (11 lux) at the walking surface while occupied. Limit: Proposal: a zone on an egress path with no measured level gets no dim.
building.limit_air_handler: Caps how fast an air handler's fans run until the end time. Use when a sale needs less fan power and its zones already run warmer or sit in standby. Not to stop fans, and not on outdoor air units. Response: Sent at the next 5-minute step. After it ends: Speed goes back to the BMS at end, with no stored load. Limit: percent while the building is open. Limit: Each unit's floor is the highest of its outdoor air, coil and heat minimums. Limit: A cap never raises a fan.
building.limit_ev_charging: Lowers or pauses EV charging on a port group until the end time. Use when a sale needs less power and cars are charging. Not when no car is charging, or a car must leave before the end time. Response: Autel answers an OCPP call within 11 s, and 0.37 s on average in test. After it ends: Cars catch up when the limit ends. Limit: Keep every AC port inside the J1772 range. Limit: Use the installed product's range. Limit: Where ChargePoint Power Share is wired, two ports share one circuit.
building.set_battery: Charges, discharges or holds the campus battery. Use when a sale needs stored power: discharge in its window, charge or hold before. Not when a utility command is on, or the battery tripped in the last 10 minutes. Response: Not stated on any sheet. After it ends: The energy comes back as new load. Limit: kw stays inside the installed battery's planning rating. Limit: Generac's overload isn't for planning. Limit: With hold, kw is 0.
building.set_plant_demand_limit: Lowers how hard the chillers can run, as a percent of full power. Use when zones already run warmer, a sale needs less cooling and the plant must keep running. Not when the plant is cleared to stop. Response: The chiller starts to unload as soon as the limit lands. After it ends: At end the cap clears and chillers reload. Limit: Carrier 19DV: stay inside the demand limit range. Limit: Carrier 30XV: never write under the read-only min_lim point. Limit: YORK YZ: the guard holds the floor.
building.set_zone_cooling: Lets a zone group run warmer, or pre-cools it, until the end time. Use when cooling runs, a sale needs less and the zone is still normal, or to pre-cool. Not in labs, closets or rooms in an exam. Response: Sent at the next 5-minute step, then ramped. After it ends: Stored heat comes back when it ends: office at +3 C after 1 C pre-cool, about 3,130 kWh of heat, about 710 kWh of. Limit: Offset while people may be in. Limit: Offset in empty zones. Limit: Guideline 36 demand levels, where the BMS runs them.
building.set_zone_standby: Lets a free zone cut air and cooling until the end time. Use when a zone is free or a wing is closed, before a fan cap. Not if the building is open and any room lacks a sensor. Response: The mode lands at the next 5-minute step. After it ends: At end the zone goes back to its schedule, and air and cooling return. Limit: mode is on or off. Limit: Setback range for any zone thermostat. Limit: Start and end are both required, and end comes after start.
building.stop_plant_early: Stops the whole cooling plant until the end time. Use when a sale needs all the cooling power and the plant is cleared to stop. Not for a plant that serves labs or is shared with another building. Response: Minutes. After it ends: None that evening if the plan holds. Limit: Whole plants only. Limit: Trane ACR and Daikin AWV: no write until a stop point is confirmed. Limit: Condenser water stays inside every maker's range.
building.switch_plugs: Turns off wall outlets in one group until the end time. Use when a sale needs less outlet power and rooms are empty, or for a kiosk group. Not in other occupied rooms, or for network, security or medical loads. Response: The relay opens on the first write. After it ends: At end the plugs go back to their sensor or schedule. Limit: Each relay's load stays within its rating. Limit: Each relay's load stays within its rating. Limit: Start and end are both required, and end comes after start.

home.delay_appliance: Delays a dryer or dishwasher. Use when kW are owed and it reads waiting. Not when 0 kW are owed, the machine is running or would miss the done-by time, or a dryer would run with people asleep or out. Response: Not stated. After it ends: The whole cycle runs after end, at full power. Limit: The delay stays inside the machine's own range. Limit: end plus the cycle minutes must be at or before finish_by. Limit: With no sale on or coming today, send nothing.
home.discharge_car: Sends car power to the home. Use when car status is idle and kW are owed after the battery gives all it can. Not when 0 kW are owed, or car status is charging, capped, giving, away or reserved. Response: Not stated for a commanded discharge. After it ends: The car owes back what it gave, and it must be back before it leaves. Limit: Keep to the GM kit's rating. Limit: Keep to Tesla Powershare's rating. Limit: Keep to Quasar 2's rating.
home.limit_ev_charging: Lowers or pauses car charging until the end time. Use when a sale has kW owed and car status is charging. Not when 0 kW are owed, or car status is idle, capped, giving, away or reserved. Response: No charger sheet states how fast a car follows a new limit. After it ends: The car makes up what it missed after end, at the circuit's rate. Limit: A cap may only go down. Limit: Nothing passes the circuit rating, not even the owner's now. Limit: Keep to the lowest setting.
home.set_battery: Charges, discharges or holds the battery. Use when a sale needs stored power: discharge in the window, charge or hold before. Not when 0 kW are owed, the battery shut off under 10 minutes ago, or a maker's event runs. Response: Seconds at the unit, once a command lands. After it ends: The energy comes back as new load unless solar refills it. Limit: kw stays inside the installed product's limit for that action. Limit: With hold, kw is 0. Limit: A charge or discharge needs more than 0 kW. At 0 it's blocked, and the answer says to use hold or no_action.
home.set_pool_pump: Slows the pool pump until the end time. Use when kW are owed and the pump reads running. Not when 0 kW are owed, the pump reads 33 percent or less, air reads cold, or filter hours read short. Response: Not stated. After it ends: At end the pump goes back to its schedule, and code adds make-up time: hours cut x (1 - new speed / normal speed), at. Limit: Speed stays at or under the installer's setting, so maximum design flow is not exceeded. Limit: Speed stays inside the installed pump's range. Limit: 0 only where the pump offers no other speed.
home.set_room_ac: Changes window air conditioners until the end time. Use when a window unit is cooling and kW are owed, or to pre-cool. Not when 0 kW are owed, that unit's can_give_kw is 0, or the owner just changed that unit. Response: No source gives the time for load to fall. After it ends: The stored heat has to be paid back after end. Limit: The resulting setpoint stays inside the unit's range. Limit: Code rounds toward the normal setting to the unit's step, and says so with adjusted. Limit: Where a unit's step is not stated, it moves in whole degrees.
home.set_thermostat: Changes the thermostat until the end time. Use when central air or a heat pump runs and kW are owed, or to pre-cool or pre-heat. Not when 0 kW are owed, can_give_kw is 0, or the owner just changed it. Response: The write lands at the next step. After it ends: The stored heat has to be paid back after end. Limit: The resulting setpoint stays inside the installed thermostat's range. Limit: In auto mode only the active side moves, and heat and cool keep the thermostat's minimum gap. Limit: Code rounds toward the normal setting, to the device's step, and says so with adjusted.
home.set_water_heater: Stops or starts water heating. Use when a sale is on or coming: hold in it, load_up a below-normal tank before. Not when 0 kW are owed, hot water reads low for hold, or a sale is on for load_up. Response: Not stated. After it ends: The heat comes back after a hold at compressor power. Limit: The tool writes no temperature. Limit: A set point under 120 °F blocks both actions. Limit: Send nothing while a heater runs its start-up check.
